Class OrinPoseSourceIO

java.lang.Object
frc.robot.subsystems.vision.OrinPoseSourceIO
All Implemented Interfaces:
PoseSourceIO
public class OrinPoseSourceIO extends Object implements PoseSourceIO
The Orin camera's pose source: reads the camera into logged OrinCameraInputs, then solves poses from those inputs with OrinSolver. It is derived: in replay the camera IO is OrinCameraIO.NONE, the raw inputs come back from the log, and the solve runs again, so mounts, the solver and its filters can all be changed and re-run against a match.

      Parameters:
      cameraName - PhotonVision camera name; also the log path
      io - the camera (OrinCameraIO.NONE in replay)
      solver - this camera's solver
      excludedTags - tags to leave out of single-tag solves (section 12)
      headingAt - robot heading at a capture time, or null if not known yet

    • derived

      public boolean derived()
      Description copied from interface: PoseSourceIO
      Whether this IO computes its observations from inputs it logs itself, rather than reading a device. A derived IO runs in replay too (over its own replayed inputs), so PoseSource records its observations as outputs instead of restoring them from the log.
